name: Ayush Rao
headline: Software Engineer – AI/ML & Data Engineering
summary: Computer Science and Engineering graduate with hands-on experience across Power Platform reporting (Power BI, Copilot Studio, Power Automate), SQL Server, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph). Skilled in building low-code automation solutions, enterprise reporting systems, and full-stack applications (React, FastAPI, Django). Continuously expanding expertise through focused training in multi-agent orchestration and Snowflake cloud data warehousing.

bullets: Engineered 3 Power BI reports within the FTBA project’s reporting pod, architecting customer-data visualizations and validating visual-layer outputs against SQL Server for accuracy.
Architected REF Agent, a low-code conversational solution built on Copilot Studio and Power Automate, orchestrating automated workflows triggered by real-time user interactions on Microsoft Teams.
Completed advanced training in multi-agent system design using LangChain and LangGraph, engineering a proof-of-concept for multi-level agent orchestration.

Spearheaded development of a reporting agent for the Executive Sponsorship Survey initiative, integrating Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and Power BI to deliver insights sourced from an enterprise semantic model.
Pursuing specialized Snowflake training, culminating in a capstone project demonstrating applied proficiency in cloud data warehousing and engineering.
Assisted senior IT engineers in monitoring SAP FM and SAP MM modules, ensuring smooth system operation and data integrity.
Supported rollout and training of SAP ERP to employees, facilitating seamless ERP integration across the organisation.

projects.title: Executive Sponsorship Survey – Reporting Agent
bullets: Built and deployed a reporting agent for the Executive Sponsorship Survey initiative using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate, automating workflows and reducing manual effort.
Integrated data from an enterprise semantic model with Power BI, enabling reliable, data-driven survey reporting and improving consistency across reporting outputs.
Optimized the reporting workflow by automating repetitive data and reporting tasks, enabling stakeholders to access survey insights more efficiently.

projects.title: UrbanMart – Omnichannel Retail Intelligence Platform
bullets: Built an end-to-end omnichannel retail analytics platform in Snowflake, integrating orders, products, inventory snapshots, and semi-structured customer clickstream data across store, web, and mobile channels.

Designed a layered data architecture with dedicated ingestion, transformation, and analytics zones, implementing data loading, validation, JSON parsing, and enriched analytical datasets for cross-channel reporting.

Implemented Snowflake capabilities including Time Travel, zero-copy cloning, secure data sharing, RBAC, dynamic data masking, network policies, and performance optimization to improve data governance, recovery, and platform efficiency.

Developed analytics and executive reporting solutions covering sales performance, inventory health, delivery metrics, customer behavior, and AI-powered insights using Snowflake Cortex, supporting faster and more data-driven business decisions.
